description.text: GX Start Decks, nine 60-card decks released together on 13 July 2018, one for each type: Grass Lurantis, Fire Charizard, Water Lapras, Lightning Raichu, Psychic Mewtwo, Fighting Lycanroc, Darkness Yveltal, Metal Metagross and Fairy Xerneas, each led by its Pokémon-GX. Every card is a non-holo reprint from earlier products, and each deck came with only paper damage counters, markers and a GX marker, no coin or playmat. They proved far more popular than expected: in August the official site apologised that they were in short supply until a new shipment in mid-September. This set holds the cards of all nine.
